security_argument.claim: Enc'(m) = Enc(T_k(m)) with T_k a public or transmitted bijection is exactly as secure as Enc.
security_argument.sketch: Any adversary against Enc' applies T_k (known) to its chosen plaintexts and T_k^{-1} to any recovered plaintext, giving an adversary against Enc with identical advantage; conversely Enc' inherits every security property of Enc. Secrecy of k adds at most log2(keyspace) bits, here 15, and only if k is never transmitted.
